1.d4 f5 2.Qd3 g6 3.g4.strategy: Attacks f5 twice against the single defence of the g6-pawn, so Black must settle the tension. The lunge gambits a pawn for open lines against a fianchetto set-up that has not yet castled, and it loosens White's own kingside in the process.
1.d4 f5 2.Qd3 g6 3.g4.name: Dutch Defence: Manhattan Gambit, Anti-Leningrad
